title: Card pack
description: One file of cards for a topic: content/<topic>/<pack-name>.json. The limits here are enforced by `npm run check`.

id.description: Permanent, unique, lowercase: the topic id, a hyphen, then a short slug, e.g. "sci-banana-radiation". Never changed or reused once merged. Also the image file name.

title.description: The hook. One line that is literally true and reads on its own.

body.description: The fact itself in two or three plain sentences, with the specific numbers, names and dates.

takeaway.description: Why it matters or how to use it. Adds something new; does not restate the body.

source.description: Who says so and when: author or institution, publication, year. No URLs.

visual.description: A concrete scene for the illustration, written as a noun phrase. No text, letters or numbers in the scene.
